title: Smull's Legislative Hand Book, 1909, general election 1908-11-03, presidential electors and Representatives in Congress by county

offices.president: Presidential electors, counties down, one column per party ticket headed by its presidential and vice-presidential candidates (vote for the first elector of each ticket)
offices.house: Representative in Congress, one table per district, counties down (Philadelphia by ward), a column per candidate and party line; several party-line columns for one candidate are fused
